rebalance.description: FanIndex maintains its indices through a transparent, rule-based rebalance process — the same operational discipline expected from traditional ETF infrastructure.

monthly.title: Monthly Cadence
monthly.description: Constituents and weights are reviewed and rebalanced on a fixed monthly schedule.

rules.title: Rule-Based Methodology
rules.description: Selection driven by liquidity, market capitalisation, and on-chain activity thresholds.

onchain.title: On-Chain Execution
onchain.description: Rebalances are executed atomically through audited smart contracts on Chiliz.

public.title: Public Factsheets
public.description: Methodology, holdings, and rebalance events are documented and verifiable.

portfolioPage.title: My
portfolioPage.description: Track and manage your Fan Token index positions with real-time on-chain analytics.

deposit.title: Deposit CHZ
deposit.description: Select an index and deposit CHZ. Smart contracts execute proportional purchases of all underlying Fan Tokens automatically.

receive.title: Receive NFT
receive.description: A unique NFT is minted to your wallet. It certifies your position — index type, deposited value, allocation data, and timestamp.

track.title: Track Performance
track.description: Monitor your positions, allocations, and real-time exposure directly on-chain with full transparency.

redeem.title: Redeem Anytime
redeem.description: Burn your NFT to redeem. The protocol sells the underlying portfolio and returns CHZ to your wallet — zero exit fee.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: FanIndex ("we," "our," or "us") operates the fanindex.pro website and related services. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use our services.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.intro: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as:
items: Wallet address and blockchain transaction data
Email address (if you opt-in for communications)

use.title: How We Use Your Information
use.intro: We use the information we collect to:
items: Process transactions and send related information
Respond to your inquiries and requests
Analyze usage patterns to enhance user experience

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

blockchain.title: Blockchain Transparency
blockchain.content: Please be aware that transactions on the Chiliz Chain and other blockchain networks are public and transparent. Any information recorded on the blockchain is permanently visible to all network participants.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@fanindex.pro
